title: Live files A2: server member routes (live or snapshot, PUT, reveal, watch, audit)
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md (revision 2) sections 3 (L1, L2, L4, L5, L14, L18, L21 to L29), 5.2, 6.2, 6.3, 7.2, 7.3, 7.5, 12, 15 (A2). Gherkin first (features/computer_file_live.feature, tag @server).

Owns these scenarios: every @server scenario in the Reading, Writing, Audit, Secrets, "Who may" and "editing while the computer is off" groups that go through a member route: LF-1 to LF-14, LF-17 to LF-20, LF-22 to LF-27, LF-47 to LF-52, LF-54, LF-57 (member side), LF-58 of the traceability table in section 13, and the watch route scenarios of "An open panel makes the owner poll every second" family that need the route (shared with A1).

Files:
- conversation/src/http/routes/computer-files.ts: choose live or snapshot with liveFileSourceOf; live GET list/stat/content with the 8 s wait loop (injected clock and sleep), abandon on timeout, fallback with fallback_reason, owner-warming short-circuit, too_busy count, mask re-check on resolved_path (L25); PUT content (7.3 steps 1 to 12, exact order); POST reveal; POST watch (7.5). Headers per 6.2. Error bodies and statuses per 6.3 (LIVE_FILE_ERROR_STATUS).
- conversation/src/http/app.ts: declareRoute PUT /orgs/:tenant_id/computer/files/content, POST .../files/reveal, POST .../files/watch (audience user).
- conversation/src/snapshot/files.ts: reveal option that skips masking, provenance fields (stale false, fallback_reason null), modified_at from the index mtime_ms, `revealed`/`editable` on content.
- conversation/src/domain/file-audit.ts (new): write intent record, finalize, flags, 90 day expires_at, fail closed (503 audit_unavailable).
- conversation/src/lambdas/front-door-composition.ts: wire the new store methods, clock and sleep.
- Steps: conversation/features-support/steps/computer-file-live.steps.ts, reusing the Phase 1 snapshot file steps for the saved copy.
- Existing scenarios that change: features/computer_snapshot_index.feature and computer-snapshot-files.steps.ts (responses gain stale, fallback_reason, modified_at; source stays "snapshot").
- On development after merge: curl shows If-Match reaches the handler and ETag returns through CloudFront (contract 6.2 ASSUMPTION); record the result in a Kanbus comment.

Acceptance (from conversation/): npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run test:features green with the owned scenarios in features/cucumber-features.txt.

Dependencies: F0 and A1 merged. Blocks W integration and E.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments, TSDoc on public exports. Writes are UTF-8 text only. Never log a path or content. Do not read or write project/.

REVISION 2 (overlay integration, owner decision O1: files are viewed and edited while the computer is off; a write never returns computer_not_live and never starts a computer):
- conversation/src/http/routes/computer-files.ts: the write route decision of section 7.3 step 4 in this order: customer-account organization -> 409 edit_unsupported; liveFileSourceOf live -> the live path; live owner with protocol below 2 -> 409 owner_too_old; stopping or stop approved and sealed by it -> 503 computer_stopping (retry_after_ms 5000); booting or hydrating and sealed by it -> 503 computer_starting (retry_after_ms 2000); otherwise the overlay path (calls the domain/edit-overlay.ts functions from A3). Every snapshot answer (list, stat, content, reveal) merges the overlay via snapshot/overlay-merge.ts (A3); a computer with no snapshot answers an empty /workspace plus the overlay. Response fields overlay, mine_sha256, variant=mine, source "overlay", backed_up.
- conversation/src/snapshot/files.ts: accept the overlay for list/stat/content/reveal.
- Existing: no live write returns 409 computer_not_live any more (section 6.3).
Dependencies (revision 2): F0, A1 and A3 merged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR 527 (A2), part of Phase 3 (contract PR 519). Proven live on development on 2026-10-13: with the computer off a person can create folders, create a file, rename it and is refused 409 on a stale hash; the next turn on a freshly started computer sees the offline edit (applied at hydrate); with the computer on, read, edit, the bot reads the edit back, delete, then stat is 404; a save with a stale hash after the bot edited is refused 409 and the bot's line survives; If-Match and ETag pass through CloudFront. Not yet proven: the Files panel in a browser at 375 px or with a real signed-in user (chatticus-bf7fd2). Follow-ups: chatticus-5dbb7e, chatticus-f9cfda, chatticus-7c6040, chatticus-d88a0f, chatticus-80b17c, chatticus-e7a52f, chatticus-ed8e4e.
